gates.unit: node --test tests/battle-san-jacinto.test.mjs tests/battle-view-san-jacinto.test.mjs, the named test and no other

unit.name: a service record fights: a man anywhere is rolled
unit.expect: presence by place: only the men standing at the Lynchburg camp are in the line; a man stranded at an old camp is not rolled and is told so

unit.name: the sick march with the army from Harrisburg
unit.expect: the army's march to Lynchburg takes every well man at Harrisburg there by the 20th; a sick man stays with the baggage, is present and not in the line, and is said so
failed: the army's march to Lynchburg takes every well man at Harrisburg there by the 20th; a sick man stays with the baggage, is present and not in the line, and is said so

unit.name: a joiner is given the camp he never reached, and stands at the old one
unit.expect: a man who joins at a camp the army has left keeps that camp and follows it at the forced march; one who arrives after the battle is told the real place
failed: a man who joins at a camp the army has left keeps that camp and follows it at the forced march; one who arrives after the battle is told the real place
